rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Connects to MongoDB Atlas or Community Edition databases and enables conversational querying through natural language. Automatically explores schemas, generates aggregation pipelines, and supports vector search with automated embeddings. Provides secure multi-tenant data separation with key/value-based isolation and advanced lookup support across collections.
